title: Hyderabad Police’s new AI tool can link suspects to criminal networks. But how does it work?
summary:
Hyderabad Police have launched Dooradrishti, an AI platform to profile accused persons and identify criminal networks, but questions remain about its data sources, accuracy and safeguards.

The post Hyderabad Police’s new AI tool can link suspects to criminal networks. But how does it work? appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: Hyderabad Police have rolled out “Dooradrishti,” an AI‑driven platform that profiles accused individuals and maps their connections to broader criminal networks. While the tool promises faster, data‑rich investigations, critics are raising concerns about the sources of its data, the reliability of its matches and the safeguards against misuse or bias.
